sections.content:
1. 26.0000130225.0241 - TCFP008 - Tree Fern Creek Rainforest Restoration
Tenders are invited for the Tree Fern Creek Restoration works for the Transport Conservation Fund Project (TCFP008).
TfNSW has identified an opportunity to expand the existing stand of subtropical lowland rainforest by approximately 2.49Ha utilising funding from the TfNSW Biodiversity Conservation Fund. The TfNSW Biodiversity Conservation Fund is a strategic initiative designed to restore and protect ecosystems across New South Wales by funding a wide range of environmental projects it aims to enhance biodiversity and landscape connectivity by transforming non-operational transport land and surrounding reserves into viable habitats that support native flora and fauna.
Further information is provided in the Request for Tender Suite of Documents.
A site inspection will be held with an invitation to be extended to participating companies subsequent to the release of the RFT.
Attendance is mandatory to submit a conforming tender submission.
All tenderers must comply with the Transport Statement of Business Ethics through the procurement process and any subsequent contract period.
All tenderers must comply with the NSW Government Procurement Policy Framework, NSW Government Supplier Code of Conduct and New South Wales Industrial Relations Guidelines: Building and Construction Procurement.
